name: Brea Mall
summary: Clothing chain with trendy apparel, shoes & accessories for teen girls & young women.
description: Brea Mall is a premier enclosed shopping destination in Orange County operated by Simon Property Group, featuring a diverse collection of popular retailers and dining options. This full-service regional mall offers an exceptional shopping experience with major department store anchors and contemporary fashion brands. Conveniently located in Brea, California, the mall serves as a central retail hub for the surrounding communities.
demographics: Brea Mall attracts a diverse, affluent demographic primarily from North Orange County communities including Brea, Fullerton, Placentia, and Yorba Linda. The typical visitor base consists of middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, appealing to both young professionals and established families with children. Shoppers are drawn to the mall's mix of accessible fashion retailers and department stores, with strong weekday traffic from local residents and increased weekend visits from broader Orange County areas. The trade area reflects the suburban character of North Orange County, with visitors seeking convenient, one-stop shopping for apparel, accessories, and family dining options.
